subject: APPLY COMMIT clause
notes: kb/Work PB3338 (wave 1154): Annex A.4.3 is now PARTIAL (docs/CONFORMANCE.md §5, §4 item 2): the APPLY COMMIT clause, COMMIT and ROLLBACK are provided for RELATIVE and INDEXED files, whose keyed store engine keeps the transaction (kb/Work PB3337); a SEQUENTIAL or LINE SEQUENTIAL file named in the clause is under commit control too, its transaction journal being kb/Work PB3340 (COBOL1709, which refused it, is retired). The derived verdict commit-and-rollback-only that stamped the module DOCUMENTED-NON-SUPPORT is retired. GR5: the clause is activated with its runtime element (TransactionEmitter.EmitActivation); a CANCEL or an INITIAL program's return retires it (TransactionEmitter.EmitRetire, TransactionControl.Retire), and the next COMMIT or ROLLBACK deactivates it. pb3338_ec_flow_apply_commit_under_sort also activates the clause at a CALL after the SORT, and its ROLLBACK restores the item saved at that activation (review finding w1154a R1-2). retired-witness: conformance:wiseowl/cases/12.4.6.3-APPLY-COMMIT/declined-apply-commit (the commit and rollback facility is provided for the keyed organizations (kb/Work PB3338): the decline these witnessed is gone, and the rule is now witnessed by its own implementation) retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Validation/DeclinedFacilityPass.cs#VisitApplyCommitClause (the commit and rollback facility is provided for the keyed organizations (kb/Work PB3338): the decline these witnessed is gone, and the rule is now witnessed by its own implementation)
